claims: NASA owns the Artemis II mission.
NASA leads the Artemis II mission.
Lockheed Martin built the Orion capsule.
Boeing built the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket core.
NASA's Exploration Ground Systems team based at Kennedy Space Center owns the Artemis II mission.
Lockheed Martin is the prime contractor for the Orion spacecraft.
Contractors including Airbus developed modules and systems for the Orion spacecraft.
Boeing developed the core stage of the Space Launch System (SLS).
Northrop Grumman developed the solid rocket boosters for the Space Launch System (SLS).
Lockheed Martin officially handed over the finished Orion capsule to NASA on May 1, 2025, for final launch processing.
Artemis II incorporates components from commercial partners such as SpaceX and Blue Origin to support the broader, long-term Artemis program.
Artemis II is scheduled for a crewed fly-around of the Moon in 2026.
Artemis II features astronauts from NASA and the Canadian Space Agency.
